summary.text: Glenn Barnes represents District 65 in the Arkansas House of Representatives, which includes parts of Jefferson and Arkansas counties, and is serving his first term.

paragraphs.text: Barnes is pastor of Pine Hill Missionary Baptist Church in Pine Bluff and previously worked as a probation officer in the Jefferson County Sixth Division Court.
He holds a bachelor's degree in business management from the University of Arkansas at Pine Bluff and a master's degree in theology from Missionary Baptist Seminary, and lives in Pine Bluff.
